record.body:
## Evidence

test_r6_product_index_shows_area_cards_with_open_idea_counts greps ProductIndex.svelte and AreaCard.svelte for attribute names. The vitest R5 test covers the behavior.

## Consequence

Phase merge is blocked until the finding is fixed or cleared.

## Follow-up

Fix task fix-area-levels-review removes the redundant source-grep test.
